subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: Should the macOS update contract short-circuit proven same-version package refreshes and clean all observed stale updater labels, or should it keep refresh behavior and rely on stronger launchd recovery proof?
rationale: Current tests intentionally preserve same-version package refresh, while the live reports show that refresh can be harmful under launchd; changing this behavior is an update-product and compatibility decision, not just a mechanical matcher patch.

options.title: Keep open and define the update contract
options.body: Treat this issue as the canonical manual updater-loop tracker and decide the no-op/dedupe, stale-label cleanup, and launchd proof requirements before implementation.

options.title: Split into narrower trackers
options.body: Move `manualupdate` cleanup, same-version update policy, launchd health proof, and node-host recovery into separate canonical issues while preserving this report as the umbrella.

options.title: Close only after live macOS proof
options.body: Close this issue only if a current-main or latest-release macOS npm-global LaunchAgent update smoke proves no stale jobs, no restart storm, and healthy Gateway/node recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep open and define the update contract
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the canonical manual updater-loop tracker and decide the no-op/dedupe, stale-label cleanup, and launchd proof requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from related maintainer comments and recent macOS update recovery commits.
